applicableAreas: Biofiltration/detention pond footprint (NE corner, Unit 501 area)
findings.comment: Sheet 15 (Biofiltration-Detention Pond Plan) shows electrical (E) and wastewater (WW) utility lines routed directly through the biofiltration/detention pond footprint, crossing through the sedimentation basin and biofiltration media. Utilities must not be routed under detention or retention ponds. Revise utility routing to avoid the pond area entirely.

applicableAreas: NE corner (City of Austin drainage easement, ~0.130 acres)
findings.comment: Two perpetual recorded easements are not depicted on the submitted site plan: (1) Greenbelt Access & Use Easement (Instrument 2010070731, 0.31 acres, NE interior, no-build zone, perpetual), and (2) City of Austin Drainage Easement (Instrument 2011021137, 0.130 acres, NE corner, perpetual). These recorded easements encumber approximately 19% of the property. All recorded easements must be depicted on the site plan, plat, and all relevant working drawings before approval. Current site plan compliance cannot be verified without these critical easements shown and building layout verified against them.

applicableAreas: Transformer Pad 1 (west side, between Buildings 1 and 8)
Transformer Pad 2 (east side, between Buildings 4 and 6)
findings.comment: Transformer pads shown on the preliminary electrical design plan lack required specification and documentation. Pad dimensions must be sized per AE Design specifications (UCM § 1.5.2.6 requires customer to furnish pad per AE Design based on customer's AutoCAD site drawings). Each pad must be encumbered by a dedicated AE easement and protected by a License Agreement from AE Public Involvement (UCM § 1.10.10.3). Coordinate with Austin Energy to obtain final pad dimensions and establish recorded utility easements for each pad.

applicableAreas: Utility easement boundaries throughout property (perimeter and interior)
findings.comment: The site plan identifies utility easements but does not include copies of required License Agreements or City Manager licenses. Items placed within private AE easements require a License Agreement from AE Public Involvement per UCM § 1.10.10.3. Items within public utility easements or public ROW require a City Manager license per § 14-11-41. Submit copies of all required licensing documentation for any structures, paving, or landscaping proposed within recorded easement boundaries before approval.

applicableAreas: Entire site (former assisted living facility demolished; existing utility remnants)
findings.comment: The property was previously developed with an assisted living facility (demolished June 2022). Abandoned utility infrastructure from the prior use may remain on site or in ROW. Demolition plans must explicitly document that all abandoned utilities creating conflicts with proposed improvements have been removed, with particular attention to conflicts with the biofiltration/detention pond, new building locations, and utility routing. Provide documentation of abandoned utility removals (caps, plugs, abandonments) prior to construction.
